name: ai-software-delivery-room
description: Multi-agent software delivery for Claude. Starts where you choose (it recommends the best start point and converts your own documents); idea validation with a synthetic persona panel; discovery with flows and test cases; architecture, cloud and configurable decisions you make, with costs; sprints with independent QA and live browser tests; a per-role model plan to cut cost; reports, manuals, a dashboard; assessments of existing systems.
